question: Identify ordinary catalog guide and wood-drill candidates for the separate Z180 matched-pair fixture, retaining nominal product dimensions as source facts rather than actual tool fit or qualification.

Acme_standard_H_dimensions.locator: Printed page12, ANSI/Acme TypeH, H-40-12 row; C column explicitly specifies length under head, unlike metric HM overall length.

facts.applicability: Corroborates the ANSI dimensional convention. Does not substitute Acme product tolerances, retention or resistance for Carr Lane.

Carr_Lane_H.locator: 5/8-inch OD table, H-40-12 row; ID Tolerance; OD Tolerance; No-Counterbore Option; part drawing

facts.family: H-40-12 with a configured 13/32-inch drill ID; exact four-decimal ordering suffix is not selected
facts.installation_type: Permanent headed press fit; entrance radius and effective drill bearing length must be distinguished from catalog dimensions.

Carr_Lane_installation.locator: Tolerances for Bushing Concentricity; Essential Steps for Preparing Holes; 5/8-inch OD table

facts.mount_hole_preparation: Jig-bore or ream; an ordinary drilled receiving hole is not a catalog precision press-fit qualification.

Carr_Lane_design.locator: Measure Chip Clearance Requirements, Figure10-45; Prepare an Installation Hole

facts.gap_scope: General-purpose drilling guidance, not a wood-specific mandatory value or verified permission for zero-gap flush drilling. Any adopted gap changes reach and angular/play bounds.

FISCH_pen_drill.locator: Printed page85; PEN DRILL013P; 13/32-inch row and NL/GL/S diagram

facts.disposition: Long-flute dimensional alternative only. Do not select a tang-drive metal-drilling product solely because the flute and overall lengths are sufficient.

disposition.first_catalog_wood_bit_candidate: FISCH013P1032150, subject to separately computed reach, actual chuck engagement, point/diameter/flute and guide compatibility. No purchase or physical use is adopted.

retention: The one-page primary FISCH PDF remains ACTIVE in the ignored catalog-cache-v1 for linked consumers; no archive or pruning is authorized. Source facts are compact; no full manuals or installations copied.
